properties.site-address: Milfield First School Site, Wheatriggs, Milfield (brownfield parcel)
properties.notes: Former school site highlighted for potential residential redevelopment. A Council-owned site that has been declared surplus and available for redevelopment following clearance. Mixed in nature but playing fields to be excluded from any proposal and development limited to the footprint of the old school buildings. Brownfield in part (0.21ha) - indicative yield of around 6 dwellings can be calculated based on methodological approach. Previous application was refused for 33 two- and three-bed two-storey dwellings following demolition (17/03961/FUL). This proposal encompassed the whole site, both greenfield and brownfield land. However, this does not prevent a suitable scheme coming forward in the future following a revised proposal being deemed appropriate. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 1518) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 0.91ha.
